intro: From Siliguri, a school in the plains and a resort in the Darjeeling hills can both be reached within a few hours, yet they need quite different playgrounds. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to buyers on both sides of that line: schools, housing complexes and parks in the city, and hotels and campuses up in the hills. We make it at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,780 km away.

Siliguri is the main road and rail gateway to the Northeast, Sikkim and the Darjeeling hills. The plains around it are hot and very wet in the monsoon, while the hills are cool, misty and steep. Tell us where your site is, how big it is and who will use it, and send a few photos. We will suggest equipment and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Plains sites and hill sites around Siliguri
sections.html:
On the plains, the main concerns are heat, humidity and standing water after heavy rain. Raise the play area slightly, slope it towards a drain and lay rubber flooring on top. Shade over slides helps from April to June.

In the hills, flat ground is the challenge. Plan a levelled terrace with a drain on the uphill side, and grout posts into firm ground rather than loose fill. Mist and damp encourage moss on shaded decks, so scrub them now and then. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit both settings. For Sikkim, see our Gangtok page, or our West Bengal page.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in the Darjeeling hills?
faq.a: Yes, once a level area is ready. We deliver by road and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India. Share photos of the slope and the road access first.

faq.q: What surface works on the plains around Siliguri?
faq.a: Rubber flooring on a slightly raised, well-drained base. It dries quickly after heavy rain and cushions falls better than soil or grass.

faq.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment in Siliguri too?
faq.a: Yes. Our Fun Fitness range suits parks, societies and campuses. See our outdoor gym page for Siliguri, or ask us to add a fitness corner to your layout.

intro: For a site as far from Vasai as Singrauli, the smartest equipment is the kind that rarely needs a spare part. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,140 km away, and supplies schools, colonies and parks across Singrauli by road.

Singrauli, on the Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh border, is known as an energy hub, with coal mines and large power stations. Many of its colonies and schools are run by the companies that operate them. Share the size of your site, the age of the children and a few photos. We will suggest a mix of equipment that keeps maintenance low and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Choosing parts that wear least on a remote site
sections.html:
Most wear on a playground happens at moving parts. Swing hooks, spring rider springs and merry-go-round bearings are the items that need replacing first, and they carry a one-year warranty. Fixed pieces such as slides, climbers and decks have no moving parts and need far less attention.

A good balance for a remote colony is a fixed multi play structure as the main piece, with only a few swings or spring riders around it. Keep one or two spare springs or bearings in the colony store, so a worn part can be swapped without waiting. Summers here are very hot and dusty. See our Madhya Pradesh page or nearby Varanasi.

faq.q: Which parts of playground equipment wear out first?
faq.a: Moving parts such as springs, bearings and swing hooks. They carry a one-year warranty. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry three years and wear far more slowly.

faq.q: Can we order spare parts to keep on site?
faq.a: Yes. Contact our after-sales team at aftersales@funplaysystems.com or +91 738 530 0921 with the product name and the part you need.

faq.q: Do you supply company colonies in Singrauli?
faq.a: Yes. We supply company colonies, schools and public bodies. You receive a layout drawing and a detailed quote that can go through your internal approval process.

intro: Not every playground we make goes to a school or a park. Families in and around Sirsa often ask for a few pieces for a farmhouse lawn or the courtyard of a large home. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these private sites, as well as for schools and colonies, at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,150 km away.

Sirsa lies in the cotton-growing west of Haryana, close to the Rajasthan and Punjab borders, with very hot summers and cold winters. Delivery is by road, with installation by our own team or a north Indian dealer. Tell us the size of the lawn, the ages of the children and send a photo or two. We will suggest pieces that fit and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Playground equipment for a farmhouse or home lawn
sections.html:
For a home, two or three pieces are usually enough. A swing set, a slide and a spring rider keep young children busy, and a small climber suits older ones. If grandparents sit outdoors, a garden swing for adults fits the same lawn.

Place the play area where you can see it from the house or verandah, away from the driveway and any water tank. Lawns in Sirsa dry out in summer, so lay rubber flooring under the swing and slide rather than relying on grass. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit the heat and the winter damp. See our Haryana page.

faq.q: Do you sell playground equipment for private homes?
faq.a: Yes. We supply single pieces and small sets for farmhouses and home lawns, as well as for schools and parks. Share your lawn size and photos to get started.

faq.q: What is a good starting set for a home?
faq.a: A swing set, a slide and a spring rider suit most young families. Add a small climber for older children if the space allows. We show the fit on a layout drawing.

faq.q: Can you colour the equipment to suit our home?
faq.a: Yes. There are more than 15 shades for the roto-moulded parts, and design customisation is available on request. We confirm colours with you before manufacturing.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Fact sheet 'nearby' for Sirsa lists Gorakhpur, which is in eastern Uttar Pradesh, far from Sirsa. Not linked; please check.

intro: A new private school in Siwan has a lot to finish before the first session starts, and the playground is often planned last. It goes more smoothly if it is planned alongside the building. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and public spaces in Siwan, at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,400 km away.

Siwan is a district town in north-western Bihar, on the flat Gangetic plains near the Uttar Pradesh border, with hot summers and a wet monsoon. Equipment goes there by road, and a dealer in eastern India or our own team installs it. Share the school's site plan, the classes you will start with and a few photos. The layout we send back shows where each piece sits and the clear space it needs.

sections.h: Planning a playground while the school is being built
sections.html:
Mark the play area on the site plan early, before the building contractor uses that land to store sand, steel or debris. Ask the contractor to level it and lay drainage while machines are still on site, as this costs less now than later.

Schedule installation after plastering and painting are done, so the equipment is not splashed or damaged. For a school opening with nursery and primary classes only, start low. Good first pieces are 3 ft slides, spring riders and a see-saw, and leave room for larger equipment as higher classes are added. See our Bihar page.

faq.q: When should a new school order its playground equipment?
faq.a: Plan it with the building, then order once the opening date is clear. Install after plastering and painting are finished so the equipment is not damaged by construction work.

faq.q: Can we add more equipment as the school grows?
faq.a: Yes. Our layout drawing can show the full play area, with space kept for later pieces. You order the first set now and add the rest as new classes start.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Siwan?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road from our Vasai factory and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

intro: Keeping a lawn green through a Solapur summer takes a lot of water, and the patch under a swing or slide rarely survives it. That is why most play areas here end up on dusty, hard ground. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment and rubber flooring to schools, housing societies and gardens in Solapur, made at our factory in Vasai East, about 370 km away.

Solapur, in the south-east of Maharashtra, is known for its textile mills, its chaddars and towels, and the Siddheshwar temple by the lake. The climate is hot and dry, and the monsoon is lighter than on the coast. Tell us how big the site is and who will use it, and attach a few photos. We will recommend equipment and flooring together, on a drawing that shows the safe play area.

sections.h: A play surface that does not need watering
sections.html:
Rubber flooring needs no water at all, and it cushions falls far better than hard, dry soil. Lay it on a compacted, level base with a slight slope, so the occasional heavy shower drains off. Sweep it every few days to remove dust and leaves.

Around the play area, use paving or hardy plants that need little water, and keep any lawn outside the safe play area. Solapur's afternoons are very hot from March to May, so place slides where a building or tree shades them, and choose lighter colours for seats and decks. For a Maharashtra project, see Raymond, Thane, or our Maharashtra page.

faq.q: What surface should we use under play equipment in a dry city?
faq.a: Rubber flooring on a compacted base. It needs no watering, cushions falls and is easy to sweep clean. We supply it along with the equipment.

faq.q: How do we keep slides cool in Solapur's summer?
faq.a: Place them in the shade of a building or tree, turn them away from the afternoon sun and choose lighter colours for the surfaces children touch.

faq.q: Do you install in Solapur?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory, about 370 km away, and install through our own team or a local dealer.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Temple name used as Siddheshwar in common English spelling; written here as Siddheshwar by mistake if present. See fix.

intro: In a Sonipat residential society, the resident welfare association usually decides what goes into the play area, and a decision by committee needs something clear to look at. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for societies, schools and campuses in Sonipat. Our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, is about 1,150 km away, and we deliver by road.

Sonipat sits just north of Delhi along the Grand Trunk Road, and its townships and university campuses have grown quickly. Weather here follows Delhi, with harsh summers, a short monsoon and foggy winters. Send us the size of the space, photos and the rough number of children in the society. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked for your committee.

sections.h: Getting an RWA to agree on a play area
sections.html:
Show residents the layout drawing along with the product photos. It answers the questions that come up at every meeting: where the equipment goes, how much space it takes and how close it sits to the towers. Mark which pieces suit toddlers and which suit older children, so parents of both can see their needs covered.

Residents on lower floors often worry about noise, so place the play area away from bedroom windows where you can. Let the committee choose colours from our more than 15 shades. A multi play station with a few individual pieces suits most society gardens. See our Haryana page.

faq.q: Can you send drawings for our RWA meeting?
faq.a: Yes. Every quote comes with a layout drawing showing each piece, the safe play area and where it sits on your site. It is easy to share with residents before a vote.

faq.q: Can the committee choose the colours?
faq.a: Yes. You can choose from more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, and we confirm the final scheme with you before manufacturing starts.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Sonipat?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer in north India, using the self-standing or grouting method that suits the ground.

intro: Open ground is scarce in South Dumdum, so many newer housing projects put their children's play area on a podium or a terrace. Equipment on a concrete slab cannot be fixed the way it is in a garden. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these sites, and for schools and parks, at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,650 km away.

South Dumdum lies in the northern part of the Kolkata metropolitan area, close to the airport, with dense housing and a humid climate. Our own team or a dealer in eastern India handles installation after road delivery. First tell us whether your site is on natural ground or on a slab. Then share the size and a few photos, and we will suggest equipment with a layout drawing marking the safe play area.

sections.h: Play areas on podiums and terraces
sections.html:
A podium slab has waterproofing that must not be broken, so digging pits for grouted footings is not possible. Self-standing equipment, which rests on its own base, is the usual answer. Ask your structural engineer to confirm that the slab can carry the load of the equipment and the children using it.

Lay rubber flooring over the slab so falls land on a cushioned surface, and keep the drainage outlets clear, since the monsoon here is long and heavy. Keep climbing equipment well away from parapet walls and railings. Compact pieces such as a small multi play unit or spring riders suit podiums. See also our Kolkata page.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a terrace or podium?
faq.a: Yes, using self-standing equipment that does not need pits. Your structural engineer should confirm the slab can take the load before we finalise the layout.

faq.q: What flooring goes on a concrete slab?
faq.a: Rubber flooring. It cushions falls and protects the slab surface. Keep drainage outlets open so rainwater does not collect under it.

faq.q: Do you supply schools and parks in South Dumdum too?
faq.a: Yes. We supply schools, housing complexes, clubs and municipal parks, and we deliver by road to any part of the Kolkata metropolitan area.

intro: Sri Ganganagar has some of the hottest summer days in India, and on an open ground a slide can become too hot to use by late morning. Shade has to be part of the playground plan from day one. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and gardens in Sri Ganganagar at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,180 km away.

The city lies at the northern tip of Rajasthan, in a canal-irrigated farming belt known for its kinnow orchards. Winters swing the other way, with cold nights and foggy mornings. We send everything by road, and a dealer in north India or our own team does the installation. Share your site size, photos and the age group, and we will suggest equipment and shade with a layout drawing of the safe play area.

sections.h: Planning shade for a hot canal town
sections.html:
Trees give the coolest shade, so keep any you already have and plan the play area around them. Where there are none, a pergola or gazebo next to the play area gives parents and children somewhere cooler to sit. Some multi play stations include a roof over the top deck, which helps too.

Turn slide beds to face north or east, so the afternoon sun does not fall directly on them. Choose light colours for seats and decks. In winter, the same open ground is pleasant at midday. For nearby areas, see our Sirsa page or our Rajasthan page.

faq.q: How do we stop playground equipment getting too hot?
faq.a: Use shade from trees, a pergola or a roofed structure, turn slides away from the afternoon sun and pick light colours for surfaces children touch.

faq.q: Do you make gazebos and pergolas?
faq.a: Yes. Our garden decor range includes gazebos, pergolas and benches. We show them on the layout drawing alongside the play pieces.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Sri Ganganagar?
faq.a: Yes. The equipment goes by road from our Vasai factory, and our own team or a dealer in north India installs it.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Fact sheet 'nearby' lists Gorakhpur, which is in eastern Uttar Pradesh. Not linked; please check.

intro: Srikakulam lies on the north Andhra coast, where cyclones from the Bay of Bengal arrive every few years with strong winds and heavy rain. A playground here has to stay firmly in the ground through a storm. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and parks in Srikakulam at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,160 km away.

The town sits on the Nagavali river, close to the Odisha border, with a hot, humid climate for most of the year. Coastal sites here are usually reached easily by road, and our team or a dealer in south India installs the equipment. Send us your site size, photos and the ages of the children who will play there. Our layout drawing then marks each piece and its safe play area.

sections.h: Preparing play equipment for cyclone season
sections.html:
Grouted footings in concrete hold posts much more firmly than shallow fixings, so we recommend grouting on open coastal ground. Keep the play area away from tall trees and old walls that could fall in strong wind.

When a cyclone warning is issued, tie up or remove swing seats so they do not swing into the frame, and clear loose items from around the site. Once the storm has passed, check every piece before children return. Look for bent pipes, loose bolts, washed-out soil at the footings and debris on slides. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle salt air and rain well. See nearby Visakhapatnam.

faq.q: Will playground equipment withstand a cyclone?
faq.a: Grouted footings and galvanised steel give it a much better chance. Remove swing seats when a warning is issued and inspect every piece after the storm before children play again.

faq.q: What should we check after a storm?
faq.a: Bent or damaged pipes, loose bolts, cracked plastic, washed-out soil around footings and debris on slides. Contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 if anything is damaged.

faq.q: Do you supply schools in Srikakulam district?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road to the town and the district, and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Fact sheet 'nearby' includes both berhampore (West Bengal) and berhampur (Odisha). Only Berhampur, Odisha is near Srikakulam. Not linked.

intro: In Srinagar the outdoor working season is shorter than in most of India, because the ground freezes and snow falls through the winter months. A playground that is ordered late may have to wait for spring. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, parks, hotels and colonies in Srinagar at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,650 km away.

Srinagar sits in the Kashmir valley, around the Dal Lake, with cold winters, pleasant summers and a wet spring. Equipment reaches the valley by road, and our team or a dealer in north India installs it. Tell us the size of your site and the ages of the children, with a few photos. We will then suggest equipment, send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and help you plan the timing.

sections.html:
Grouting needs ground that is not frozen and concrete that can set, so plan installation between late spring and autumn. Work back from that window: agree the layout and quote early, so manufacturing and road delivery finish before the cold sets in.

Through winter, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic cope with snow and frost far better than bare metal or untreated wood. Clear snow from decks and slides before children use them, and check footings after the thaw for any movement. Lakeside sites stay damp, so give the play area a raised, drained base with rubber flooring. See our Punjab and Jammu and Kashmir page.

faq.q: When is a good time to install playground equipment in Srinagar?
faq.a: Between late spring and autumn, when the ground is not frozen and concrete can set. Agree the layout and quote early so delivery fits that window.

faq.q: Can the equipment stay outdoors through the winter?
faq.a: Yes. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle snow and frost. Clear snow before use and check bolts and footings once the thaw begins.

faq.q: Do you deliver to the Kashmir valley?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road anywhere in India. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in north India.

intro: Parks in Sultan Pur Majra and the colonies around it are small, close to houses and full of children by evening. Equipment here takes heavy use and has to fit into tight corners. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for neighbourhood parks, schools and housing in this part of north-west Delhi. Our factory is in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,120 km away.

Lanes here are often narrow, so tell us how a delivery vehicle will reach the park when you first get in touch. Delhi's weather is hard on outdoor equipment, with very hot summers, a short monsoon and cold, foggy winters. Share the size of the park, photos and the age group, and we will suggest equipment with a layout drawing that marks the safe play area.

sections.h: Small neighbourhood parks in a dense colony
sections.html:
In a small park, a single compact structure gives more play per square foot than several pieces spread out. Put it in one corner and leave the rest of the park open for walking and games. Grout every post, because parks used by many children every evening see rough play.

Pick parts that are hard to remove or damage, and avoid small loose fittings. A see-saw or merry-go-round lets several children play at once. Ask the park caretaker to report damage early. See our Delhi and UP page or nearby Nangloi Jat.

faq.q: Can you deliver to a park in a narrow lane?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Tell us how close a vehicle can get and send photos of the approach. We plan delivery and installation around the access you have.

faq.q: What equipment holds up to heavy daily use?
faq.a: Grouted pieces in galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic, with few small loose parts. See-saws, merry-go-rounds and compact multi play units keep many children busy at once.

faq.q: Who do we call for a quote?
faq.a: Call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Include the park size and photos.

intro: A Surat builder selling flats in a new tower wants a play area that looks good on the brochure. It also has to hold up to daily use once residents move in. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for these projects, and for schools and gardens, at our factory in Vasai East, about 200 km away down the coast.

Surat is known for diamond cutting and textiles, and new residential towers keep coming up across the city. It is humid, close to the sea and gets a heavy monsoon from June to September. Share your amenity plan, the size of the play area and the age group you expect. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, ready for your architect.

sections.h: Themed play structures for high-rise societies
sections.html:
A themed structure gives a project a play area residents remember. Our Castle Crest range is built around castle towers, and Robo Romp takes its look from robots. Funplay Originals offer designs drawn from Indian games and nature.

Choose colours from more than 15 roto-moulded shades to match the building. Coastal humidity and heavy rain are hard on bare steel, so galvanised pipes and roto-moulded plastic make sense here. If the play area sits on a podium, plan self-standing pieces. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Surat, or our Gujarat page.

faq.q: Do you work with builders and architects in Surat?
faq.a: Yes. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, which your architect can place on the amenity plan. Colours and some design details can be customised.

faq.q: Do you have themed playground equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Castle Crest, Robo Romp, Clown Capade and Forestia are themed CoreCraft ranges, and Funplay Originals are designed by our own team.

faq.q: How far is your factory from Surat?
faq.a: Our factory is in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 200 km from Surat. We deliver by road, and our own team or a local dealer installs the equipment.

intro: Salt is a problem for outdoor equipment in Surendranagar district, even far from the sea. The soil and groundwater here carry salt from the edge of the Little Rann of Kutch, and that attacks steel where it meets the ground. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, societies and gardens in Surendranagar and Dudhrej at our factory in Vasai East, about 400 km away.

The twin towns lie in the Jhalawad area of Gujarat, a hot and dry cotton-growing region with a short monsoon. We deliver by road and install through our own team or a dealer in western India. Share the size of your site, photos and the age group of the children. In return you get a list of suggested pieces and a drawing that marks the safe play area around each.

sections.h: Protecting posts from saline soil and hard water
sections.html:
The weakest point on any post is where it enters the ground, because moisture and salt collect there. Grout the post into a concrete footing and finish the concrete a little above ground level, sloped so water runs away from the pipe. This keeps the galvanised steel out of direct contact with salty, damp soil.

Avoid watering a lawn right up to the posts with salty borewell water. If you wash the equipment, use fresh water where you can. Roto-moulded plastic parts do not corrode at all. Summers are very hot, so plan shade. See nearby Rajkot or our Gujarat page.

faq.q: Does saline soil damage playground equipment?
faq.a: Salt and moisture can attack steel where it meets the ground. Grouting posts into concrete that finishes above ground level, and using galvanised steel, protects the base of each post.

faq.q: Can we wash the equipment with borewell water?
faq.a: Fresh water is better if your borewell water is salty or hard. Rinse with fresh water where possible and keep wet lawns away from the base of the posts.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Surendranagar and Dudhrej?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory, about 400 km away, and install through our own team or a dealer in western India.

intro: When parents bring children to a park in Suryapet, many of them would exercise too if there were something for adults nearby. Putting play equipment and an outdoor gym in the same park serves the whole family. FunPlay Systems makes both at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 750 km away, for parks, schools and colonies in Suryapet.

Suryapet sits on the highway between Hyderabad and Vijayawada, in a hot, dry part of Telangana with a monsoon from June to September. The equipment comes by road, and a dealer in south India or our own installation team fixes it on site. Share the size of your park, photos and a note on who uses it most, morning and evening. We will suggest play and fitness equipment together on one layout drawing with every safe area marked.

sections.h: Combining play equipment and an outdoor gym
sections.html:
Place the outdoor gym where parents can see the play area while they exercise, but keep the two zones apart with a path. Children should not run through the space around moving machines such as a pendulum or walker.

Low-impact machines like the Fun Walker Double and seated twisters suit parents and senior citizens. On the play side, a multi play station with a few swings keeps children busy. Both use galvanised steel, which suits the dry heat. Plan shade over slides and a few benches between the zones. See our outdoor gym page for Suryapet.

faq.q: Can a park have both playground and outdoor gym equipment?
faq.a: Yes. We plan both on one layout drawing, with separate zones and a clear path between them so children do not run into the space around gym machines.

faq.q: Which gym machines suit parents and senior citizens?
faq.a: Low-impact machines such as the Fun Walker, Tai Chi wheel and seated twisters. They use the person's own body weight and need no adjustment.

faq.q: Do you install in Suryapet?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.
